name: Pick Your Costume
description: A full-stack web application for exploring, discovering, and learning about various costumes for different occasions. Features include multi-language support, dynamic themes (Halloween, Christmas, Carnival), smart filtering, and interactive modes (Random and Guess modes). Built with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and MySQL with a responsive design optimized for all devices.

name: Road-Addict
description: Join a passionate community where enthusiasts and collectors come together to share their love for exclusive cars and motorcycles. With an interactive map, easily explore the best automotive events: rallies, exhibitions, museums, and gatherings. Looking for a rare model or hoping to connect with fellow enthusiasts? Road-Addict helps bring owners and future buyers together, turning every interaction into a custom-tailored adventure.

name: Travel Up
description: Explore the world based on your preferences with this interactive map! Answer six questions about your travel preferences (budget, climate, activities, environment…) and instantly discover destinations that best match your criteria. Using a dynamic filtering system, countries gradually light up on the interactive map, providing a fun and personalized experience to help you find your next adventure.

name: Karotaine
description: A satirical and dystopian website, designed in just two days, where a mysterious 'benevolent' government subtly imposes... carrots! In this post-apocalyptic world, citizens can search for recipes, but the filter inevitably directs them towards carrot-based dishes. Featuring a 'contact' form that is actually used to report dissenters, this project parodies authoritarian regimes with a touch of absurd humor, inspired by the universe of Bioshock.

name: Sandra's Market
description: Discover the magic of Christmas markets around the world! Be enchanted by twinkling lights, handcrafted treasures, and the delightful aromas of mulled wine and gingerbread. With our interactive map, explore the most beautiful Christmas markets and immerse yourself in local traditions. Find unique gifts, share magical moments, and let the holiday spirit captivate you!

name: Cocktail Finder
description: Discover personalized cocktails based on your available ingredients! An immersive web application with retro-futuristic 80s-inspired design. Features include cocktail search by name or ingredient, neon interface with light animations, responsive design, secure authentication system (JWT), and user favorites management. Built with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and MySQL.
